summary.text: Toby Thompson is the Republican candidate for the Oklahoma House of Representatives, District 47, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Democrat Indigo Oliver in an open-seat race.

paragraphs.text: Toby Thompson has been a member of the Mustang Public Schools Board of Education, Seat 3, since January 25, 2023; his current term ends in 2028.
He won that seat in the 2023 election without appearing on the ballot.
Thompson advanced to the general election by defeating Kevan Gentry in the August 25, 2026 Republican primary runoff, 60.7% to 39.3%.
